name: Eastside Playboy Gangster Crips
description: Eastside Playboy Gangster Crips (E/S PBGC) is an older, smaller Playboy Gangster Crip-aligned clique operating along blocks on East Warren Avenue on Detroit's eastside. It is one of several PBGC factions across Detroit, distinct from the main 7 Mile corridor set, with activity documented in the East Warren and Fox Creek neighborhoods.

sources.title: Inside the Powerful Rise of Playboy Gangster Crips in Detroit
